messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - billing-metering alert. Observed persistent token-count drift vs expected for multiple accounts in the EU region. Overflag spike > 5x baseline. Paging @oncall-jess and billing-ops. Autoscrub: false.
oncall-jess: got it, I'm awake. looking at the dashboard now. any customer-facing alerts?
support-maya: yes — two customers have received overage emails. they're in the EU cluster, accounts A-762 and B-119. I've paused outbound billing emails for those tenants.
billing-ops: thanks @support-maya. preliminary check: emitter lag metrics show backlog on kafka-partition-17 and an increased retry rate. counts from the realtime tally are ~3x lower than the offline ledger for last 30m. could be double-counting upstream or a late-emit window.
sre-lee: can you paste the offending logs or offsets? also let's check the emitter consumer group lag: `kafka-consumer-group --describe --group emitter-consumer-eu`
eng-alex: quick query from aggregates: `SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_rt FROM realtime.tokens WHERE ts >= now() - interval '45 minutes' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tokens_rt DESC LIMIT 10;` shows bucketed spikes for A-762 but total RT tokens are lower than batch ledger by ~2.9x. suspicious.
billing-ops: looked at the emit logs, see `WARN emitter: retrying message id=... reason=timeout` and then a later duplicate ack. pattern looks like retries combined with a downstream re-ingest. might be emitter retries causing duplicates on replay.
oncall-jess: mitigation path proposal: 1) pause emitter consumers for eu to stop new writes to tally, 2) flip `billing.overflag-suppression=true` to prevent new overage flags, 3) run a controlled reingest scrub for the last 2 hours. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sre-lee: agree on suppression flag first. pausing consumers is risky but doable if we coordinate with backfill. I'll prepare the runbook steps.
billing-ops: support for suppression toggle: `curl -X POST https://cfg.internal/flags -d '{"key":"billing.overflag-suppression","value":true}'` (run from ops bastion). Also capture current flag state for rollback.
support-maya: I've told CS to hold on outbound emails until we confirm. customers notified that we're investigating — minimal wording.
eng-alex: before pausing consumers, can we snapshot the consumer offsets and dump recent messages to S3? command: `kafka-export --group emitter-consumer-eu --since 45m --out s3://redwood-debug/eu/1718472000/`
incident-bot: runbook step created: RB-58 "EU billing duplicate-emitter mitigation". Assigned to oncall-jess, sre-lee, billing-ops.
oncall-jess: doing snapshot now, then toggling suppression. I'll post offsets once done.
eng-alex: note — if duplicates are in the ledger, simple suppression won't remove already-issued overflags. plan to mark affected invoices as "under review" and issue credits if needed.
billing-ops: snapshot complete. offsets: 1203456 -> 1206789 (posted to internal link). toggling suppression now.
oncall-jess: `curl` returned 200. suppression=true. :white_check_mark:
sre-lee: pausing emitter consumers in eu (k scale deployment/emitter-consumer-eu --replicas=0).
eng-alex: I'll start a dedupe run against the last 2 hours using job `billing-dedupe-run --window 2h --dry-run=false --tag incident-1718472000`. posting progress.
support-maya: CS updated customers that we paused automated billing emails and are investigating. they appreciate the proactive pause.
billing-ops: dedupe job dry-run shows ~0.8% of events are duplicate for the window, likely due to replays. but the biggest signal is delayed batch ingestion causing ledger>realtime mismatch.
oncall-jess: next steps: 1) continue dedupe, 2) keep suppression on for 1 hour post-dedupe, 3) plan controlled resume of consumers after backpressure cleared, 4) prep customer credit PRs. I'm handing off to @sre-lee for overnight monitoring.
sre-lee: taking over monitoring. I'll watch emitter lag, dedupe progress, and overflag counts. handoff note: contactable via pager.
eng-alex: saving artifacts: s3://redwood-debug/eu/1718472000/ and job logs at /var/logs/billing/dedupe-1718472000.log
support-maya: will queue CS templates for any customers who request details.
incident-bot: Incident RB-58 status updated: mitigation in progress, suppression toggled, dedupe job started. Severity remains P1 until overflag rate drops below 1.2x baseline for 30m.
sre-lee: quick update 21m in — dedupe at 60%, overflag rate down to 1.5x. continuing.
oncall-jess: thx team. if overflag rate is <1.2x after dedupe completes and we validated ledger parity, we can start rolling consumers back with a small canary.
sre-lee: will perform canary with 1 consumer replica, monitor duplicate acks, then scale to normal.
billing-ops: after dedupe finished, ledger vs realtime parity confirmed within 0.9x-1.1x for sampled tenants. recommending turning suppression off and resuming consumers with canary.
oncall-jess: suppression=false (turned off). resuming emitter consumers with canary 1 replica.
eng-alex: canary looks clean. no new duplicate ack spikes.
support-maya: CS: customers A-762 and B-119 have been credited for the anomalous charges and informed.
incident-bot: Incident RB-58 resolved. Summary: emitter retry/replay + delayed batch ingestion caused token-count drift and overflag cascade for some EU tenants. Mitigations: suppression flag, pause consumers, dedupe backfill, canary resume. Impact: temporary overage emails for 2 customers, credits issued. oncall handoff to overnight: sre-lee.
sre-lee: handing off to next oncall. will keep an eye overnight and escalate if any regressions. :sleeping:
